_comment: Races to hold out of a launch: each entry is {pattern, reason}; pattern is a regex on the raceKey. Held entries stay in the manifest as status 'unresolved' (no payload, no cost); the dry run lists them and apply skips them. Example for the four states most likely to redraw their House map for 2028: {"pattern": "^2028-house-(GA|MD|MO|MS)-", "reason": "map likely to change for 2028 (see inventories/house-2028-states.json)"}. Empty until Tod decides.
